events.did: 仰面瘫在古董地毯上——地点是 The Horatio Combe Institute, Priory Square, Camden（章节首行标题即此地名）
events.quote_head: The Horatio Combe Institute, Priory Square, Camden
events.quote_anchor: Digby Combe-Watson is sprawled out on the antique rug apocryphally gifted to his great-great-great-grandfather in 1849

events.who: 地毯的传说（叙述者口述）
events.did: 称地毯是 1849 年「感激的」Naser al-Din（时任伊朗 Shah）赠予其曾曾曾祖父（great-great-great-grandfather）的；Shah 当时正追随亚历山大大帝在中亚的征战脚步、在波斯波利斯废墟间作乐。地毯真正的来历是 1927 年在 Portobello Road 买的，为掩盖地板上一块难看的 port stain（酒渍），此事实现已失传。地毯还成了 Digby 谈论博物馆二楼六块尚未译出的楔形文字泥板的「跳板」
events.quote_head: apocryphally gifted to his great-great-great-grandfather in 1849 by an appreciative Naser al-Din
events.quote_anchor: It had in fact been purchased down Portobello Road to hide an ugly port stain on the floorboard in 1927

events.did: 感觉不到脚趾，说「Oh dear. It's all happening so quickly.」（毒发／濒死开始）
events.quote_head: Digby can’t feel his toes. Oh dear. It’s all happening so quickly.
events.quote_anchor: Digby can’t feel his toes. Oh dear. It’s all happening so quickly.

events.did: 措手不及地想：自己「想太多了」；这次私下见面（tête-à-tête）本来就不是好主意；像「在公共场所见面」这类基本规则只对女人适用；自己是个「soft-bodied intellectual」，只关心知识、历史的保存与重估，此刻才卑微地想要一点属于自己别的东西——他没意识到自己处于危险中；一个像他这样的男人怎么会处于危险？谁会想伤害他？
events.quote_head: Digby was taken by surprise. He’d thought better of himself.
events.quote_anchor: cardinal rules like meet in a public place applied to only women. He hadn’t realised that he was in danger.

events.did: 感觉不到腿；「寒冷、死亡之冰冷的手」正一寸一寸向上爬过身体（inch by mortal inch）
events.quote_head: Digby can’t feel his legs. The coldness, the frozen hand of death,
events.quote_anchor: is moving up his body inch by mortal inch.

events.who: Digby（观察）/ 凶手（只以一只「cold steely eye」出现，未具名）
events.did: 环顾四周，希望这是意外、援手在路上；但他知道这是蓄意为之、经过谋划。他捕捉到一双冷冷钢硬的眼睛回望自己，于是知道援手不会来了，自己将死在祖先的「morbidity」包围中——Horatio Combe（他「可憎的祖先」/ 同名研究所的 namesake）的迷狂崇拜圣龛：一位纵情帝国各处、见好就收（收集任何人和任何东西）之刺激人生的遗物；而 Digby 只在自己位于 NW1 的破旧联排住宅里，隔空向那些冒险致敬
events.quote_head: he knows this was done to him on purpose, that it had been planned. He catches a cold steely eye lazily gazing back at him
events.quote_anchor: whereas he has spent his short life paying homage to those seedy adventures from a decrepit town house in NW1.

events.did: 喉咙开始闭合；挣扎呼吸时转动头；柜中的「shrunk heads（缩头）」注视着他，他的心脏停止跳动——死亡完成
events.quote_head: Digby’s throat is beginning to close. He turns his head as he struggles to breathe.
events.quote_anchor: The shrunken heads watch from their cabinet as his heart stops.

characters.name: Digby Combe-Watson
characters.role: 受害者/第一人称叙述者；Horatio Combe 的后裔（great-great-great-grandson 辈分关系在文本中由「odious ancestor」与家传地毯两条线索给出）；住 NW1 一栋 decrepit town house；在博物馆工作（谈二楼楔形文字泥板）；自称 soft-bodied intellectual、gentle soul

characters.name: Horatio Combe
characters.role: Digby「可憎的祖先」，The Horatio Combe Institute 得名之处；其「shrine to his obsessions」内陈列他一生收集的遗物与「whoever took his fancy」的人（柜中 shrunken heads）；Digby 一直隔空向他致敬

characters.name: Naser al-Din
characters.role: 时任伊朗 Shah，据传（apocryphally）于 1849 年把地毯赠给 Digby 家族祖先；文中说明「For what the Shah was so grateful no one knew」

characters.name: Alexander the Great
characters.role: 仅被提及：Shah 当时追随其在中亚的脚步

characters.name: 凶手
characters.role: 未具名；只以「a cold steely eye lazily gazing back at him」在场的可辨识特征出现；与「Digby 主动赴约的 tête-à-tête」相呼应，但文本未点名邀约者
